title: Storage Service State
description:
A place on the board where a board keeps bytes — audio it rendered, a file
somebody uploaded, an export — addressed by path and backed by whatever the
board points it at. (Runtimes: node; IDs: storage)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

pipeline.description: The backend. Required — a store with none says so rather than inventing one

prefix.description: Confines every path to one part of the store

readOnly.description: Answers reads and refuses everything else

operation.description: What a request naming no op means (default read)
